data.name: Safeer
data.gender_notes: Safeer is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who carries a message, a traveler. The name Safeer carries the meaning “Traveler, Messenger” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Safeer usually hope their child will grow to embody traveler, messenger and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrying the message of truth and guidance to others
data.etymology: Safeer belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Traveler, Messenger.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Safeer total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: سفير
in_arabic.meaning: سفير يعني الرسول أو المبعوث أو الشخص الذي يرسل للدبلوماسية
in_arabic.long_meaning: سفير هو اسم مشتق من الفعل س-ف-ر، والذي يعني السفر أو الانتقال من مكان إلى آخر. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم مصطلح سفير للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يمثل دولة أو منظمة في علاقات دولية، ويُعرف أيضًا بالمبعوث أو الرسول. في السياق الإسلامي، قد يُستخدم الاسم للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يمثل الإسلام أو يعمل على نشر رسالته. اسم سفير ذو معنى جميل ومرتبط بالدبلوماسية والتواصل بين الشعوب.

in_urdu.name: سفیئر
in_urdu.meaning: سفیئر کا مطلب ہوتا ہے رسول، مبعوث یا سفارت کار
in_urdu.long_meaning: سفیئر ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہوتا ہے رسول یا مبعوث۔ یہ نام س-ف-ر سے مشتق ہے، جو سفر کرنے کے معنی میں ہے۔ اسلامی تقالید میں، سفیئر کو ایک ایسے شخص کے طور پر سمجھا جاتا ہے جو دینی یا سفارتی مقاصد کے لیے سفر کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر اردو بولنے والے ممالک میں، جہاں اس کا تلفظ سفیئر ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: सफीर
in_hindi.meaning: सफीर का अर्थ होता है दूत, राजदूत या संदेशवाहक
in_hindi.long_meaning: सफीर एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ होता है दूत या संदेशवाहक। यह नाम स-फ-र से व्युत्पन्न है, जिसका अर्थ है यात्रा करना। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, सफीर नाम का उपयोग एक ऐसे व्यक्ति के लिए किया जाता है जो धार्मिक या राजनयिक उद्देश्यों के लिए यात्रा करता है। यह नाम देवनागरी लिपि में लिखा जाता है और इसका उच्चारण सफीर होता है।

in_pashto.name: سفير
in_pashto.meaning: سفير دى د رسولو یا د سفارت کار معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: سفير دى يو نوم چې د س-ف-ر څخه اخستل شوى دى، چه سفر کول په معنى ده. په پښتو ژبه کې، سفير دى د هغه چا لپاره کارول کېږي چه د ډیپلوماسۍ یا مذهبي موخو لپاره سفر کوي. دا نوم په افغانستان او پښتونستان کې د مسلمانانو تر منځ مشهور دى.

in_english.name: Safeer
in_english.meaning: Safeer means messenger, envoy, or diplomat in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Safeer is derived from the Arabic root s-f-r, which means to travel or to journey. In Arabic, Safeer refers to a messenger, envoy, or diplomat, someone who travels on behalf of others to convey important messages or represent their interests. The name Safeer has been used throughout Islamic history to signify a person of great importance, often entrusted with significant responsibilities. In modern times, the name Safeer continues to be used across Muslim cultures, symbolizing qualities such as communication, diplomacy, and leadership.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Safeer" has a significant cultural impact for Muslims, as it is a direct reference to the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) role as a messenger of God. In Islamic tradition, prophets and messengers are highly revered figures, and the word "Safeer" evokes the idea of being a messenger or representative of something greater than oneself. This role of carrying God's message to the people is a deeply significant one in Islamic culture, and the name "Safeer" serves as a reminder of this duty and privilege.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Safeer" holds deep meaning for those who bear the name. It signifies a call to service and a reminder of the inherent responsibility of each individual as a representative of God in the world. Following the example of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), the name "Safeer" calls on its bearer to strive towards personal and spiritual growth, to carry out God's message with integrity and dedication, and to be a source of guidance and support for others along their own spiritual journeys. Ultimately, the name "Safeer" serves as a reminder of the sacred duty of all believers to represent God in the world and to be a conduit of His love and guidance to others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Safeer means "Messenger" or "Envoy" in Arabic. It symbolizes the role of carrying important messages or tasks from one place to another, embodying trust, dedication, and responsibility. With this name, one is called to serve as a bridge of communication between people and Allah (swt), or between different communities.

He is known for his asceticism, humility, and profound knowledge. He was known as 'Safeer al-Lah' (The Messenger of God) due to his special status.
